title: Another Word for Big: 15 Synonyms With Pictures (Memory Challenge)
description:
Another word for big? Here are 15 synonyms for big, from large to ginormous, each with a picture and its meaning.
Memory challenge: ten words in a plain list, then one silly story. How many can you remember each time? Grab a pen: you get two scores.

1. Watch the list, then pause the video and write down every word you remember. That's your list score.
2. Watch the story, then pause again and write down every word you can recall, in order. That's your story score.
3. Stay for the surprise at the end, and the whole BIG ladder on one screen.
4. Comment your two scores: list versus story.

The story goes roughly from big to extremely big: large, considerable, bulky, hefty, jumbo, huge, giant, enormous, massive, whopping, vast, towering, mammoth, immense, ginormous. For each word, you learn what it means and, for most of them, when to use it: for sizes and amounts, for money ("a hefty bill"), for products ("a jumbo pack"), before a number ("a whopping 1,200 kilos"), for feelings ("immense relief"), in more formal English, in casual chat with friends (informal), or when you want to sound a bit literary ("towering trees").

Tonight, try it with your own new words: one silly story, one picture for each word.

For more words, look up "another word for big" on anotherwordfor.net: https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-big/

#synonyms #englishvocabulary #memorychallenge
